svg.title: The data ingestion pipeline
svg.desc: A hand-drawn pipeline. Four raw source chips on the left — a born-digital PDF, an HTML crawl, a scanned image, and a spreadsheet grid — feed five stages in a row. Parse turns bytes into text with layout, reading order, and tables preserved, applying OCR to scans, and is marked as where most quality is lost. Clean strips boilerplate, headers, footers, and navigation, and deduplicates blocks. Enrich attaches provenance metadata: source, page, section, and time, which is what enables citation. Chunk and index follow, both marked as post 11's subject. A caption states that quality is set upstream of any embedding, that what the parser keeps or drops is what the model can ever retrieve, and that recall at N cannot recover a fact destroyed at parse time.
svg.text: Messy source files become clean, provenance-tagged, chunk-ready text. Quality is set upstream.
quality is set here, upstream of any embedding
What the parser keeps or drops is what the model can ever retrieve.
recall@N cannot recover a fact that was destroyed at parse time.
